Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and the PO.

Short answer: we can do both. Two options we typically offer:

1) Portal-first (recommended)
   - We'll enroll Aurora in our billing portal and push structured invoices (PDF + XML) each billing cycle.
   - Portal supports SFTP/webhook delivery to your AP ingestion as well.
   - We can configure an automated copy to ap@aurorahealth.com so your legacy system gets a PDF.

2) Email-first (fallback)
   - We can send a centralized PDF from billing@redwood.com and include the PO on each invoice.

Next steps I propose:
- We enroll Aurora in the portal and enable monthly emailed copies to ap@aurorahealth.com.
- I'll attach our VAT certificate and a sample invoice for your review.

Connor — can you start the enrollment flow for Aurora and confirm the expected file names / XML schema for their ingest team?
